svg.title: Time outside the model, and the prompt tokens of a deep agent
svg.desc: Two dot charts. Left: the milliseconds outside the model call and the tools in each task, on a log scale, for Qwen3 4B on the 30-task subset with four harnesses and for Claude Haiku 5.5 on 99 tasks with two. Medians: Qwen3 4B plain 6.2 ms, create 22.5 ms, graph 18.5 ms, deep 55.2 ms, Haiku plain 8.4 ms, deep 66.5 ms. The model took a median of 9.7 s per task on Qwen3 4B and 5.0 s on Haiku. Right: the prompt tokens of the deep agent divided by those of the plain loop, task by task, for seven models. Over all tasks the deep agent sent 3.62 to 4.35 times the prompt tokens.
svg.text: A. OUTSIDE THE MODEL, EACH TASK
B. DEEP AGENT OVER PLAIN LOOP

g.text: model time per task: 9.7 s on Qwen3 4B, 5.0 s on Haiku
